infobox.usage: Unlocks Grumpy's hideout inside the power station on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Grumpy's hideout key (Grumpy) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that unlocks the room located at the power station next to the ULTRA mall. Belonged to one of the Arena gladiators by the name "Grumpy".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: - Can only be bartered from Ref LL2

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Grumpy's hideout inside the power station on Interchange.
